jobs.title: Managing Director - Data & AI (Montreal, Canada)
jobs.description:
Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organisations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 400 projects and have grown to 175+ talented individuals across 7 office locations.

Unit8's mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and "engineering for good" causes. You can learn more about what we are passionate about at and on our you can find more useful information about our business and recruiting process.

Are You the Leader We're Looking For?

As a Managing Director
at Unit8, success isn't just about closing deals — it's about becoming a cornerstone of how we grow and deliver in the Canadian market. You will own both sides of the equation: originating high-value client relationships and ensuring the work we deliver actually moves the needle for our clients. If you've built your career at the intersection of commercial impact and technical credibility, and you're ready to operate with real autonomy in an expert-led environment, this is the role.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

This is a senior leadership position for someone as comfortable originating a complex engagement as overseeing its delivery. You shape and close the deal, build relationships and trust, and you stay close enough to ensure the technical execution actually delivers value. You will succeed by:

Building and converting a pipeline of high-value opportunities in the Canadian market — primarily in financial services — through a network earned over years of credible work in data & AI
Selling from expertise: clients engage with you because you understand their problem because of your deep problem solving skills and experience not because you have a polished pitch
Staying embedded in delivery long enough to set the right pace, challenge client assumptions, and keep teams focused on the actual business problem
Bridging the gap between a senior data scientist and a C-suite conversation — translating technical constraints into strategic decisions and vice versa
Raising the delivery bar by knowing what good looks like and holding teams to that standard

What You'll Do

Leverage your existing network to source, shape, and close high-value engagements in Canada (new logos, not just expansions)
Translate complex business problems into concrete Data & AI solutions: identify where value can be created, make sure the team is building toward it, and hold the client accountable to realising it
Lead and shape complex, tech-enabled transformations — from early problem definition through to scaled delivery — ensuring the right technology choices serve the business outcome, not the other way around
Act as the senior point of contact for key clients throughout delivery, ensuring technical execution stays anchored to business value
Challenge clients when necessary — on scope, pace, and ambition
Work closely with our engineering and data science teams, providing business context, removing blockers and coaching them

Requirements

Who You Are

You've run complex, tech-enabled transformations — perfectly from a top-tier global consultancy or a specialist data & AI firm. You have navigated high-stakes, complex engagements from ambiguity to delivery — and have the results to show for it.

You have significant experience in Data & AI consulting
, with a clear and verifiable track record of personally originating and closing major client relationships
You are currently at Principal
or Associate Partner / Director
level — or equivalent — with the commercial track record and client ownership, looking for the next step in your career

You don't need to write code, but you must "speak Tech."
You understand data architecture and AI well enough to raise our delivery bar and earn the respect of world-class engineers
You bring an established network of senior client relationships in the Canadian market
, ideally in financial services
Fluent in English.

Comfortable with traveling, including on-site engagements

Benefits

What's In It For You

At Unit8, we don't just "turn data into value" — we empower the people who make it happen. If you are looking for a place where you can say, "I am independent and I take ownership", your next chapter starts here.

Trust from Day One:
We believe in your expertise, and trust is a core part of our culture
Work that Matters:
You will do things that matter, and together we will facilitate the work of others
Passion-Led Projects:
We create an environment where you can pursue your passion alongside great talent. If the future makes you excited, you belong here
Impact:
You will be part of our leadership team and have a direct hand in shaping how Unit8 grows in Canadian market — defining our commercial approach, influencing which industries and clients we focus on, and setting the standard for how we deliver. This is not an execution role inside a fixed strategy; you help write it
Competitive compensation package.

Flexibility & Growth:
Above-the-norm flexibility on where and when you work, with up to 10% of your time dedicated to learning and pro-bono projects
Connection & Fun:
Whether it's our cross-office off-sites, online events, or a dedicated quarterly team budget for after-work activities, we make sure we stay connected

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. If you meet the qualifications and are excited about the opportunity to contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Wealth Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Requisition ID
: 276034

At Tangerine, we’re redefining banking. As Canada’s leading digital bank, we thrive on innovation, agility, and bold thinking, tackling every challenge head-on with leading technology and the unstoppable power of collaboration.

Our client-obsessed teams deliver flexible, accessible banking solutions, breakthrough products, and award-winning service. Beyond banking, we’re committed to making an impact in the communities we serve and across our organization. We foster a culture built on integrity, inclusion, and fearless ambition – where diverse perspectives are valued, and people are empowered to do their best work.

Are you ready to disrupt the status quo? Do you crave challenges that push boundaries? If you’re a high performer looking to accelerate your career and reimagine the banking landscape, this is your moment.

Let’s shape the future of banking together!

Job Purpose

Tangerine is Canada’s leading direct bank. We offer flexible and accessible banking options, innovative products, and award-winning Client service. The reason why Tangerine employees come to work each day is to help Canadians live better lives. We focus on making a difference in our communities, and that includes our own internal community. It’s important to us that our employees feel empowered and enthusiastic about belonging to our Orange culture.

As Canada’s leading digital bank, Tangerine technology is at the heart of everything we do. We have redefined what digital banking is, and we continue to evolve to tackle any opportunity and face every challenge through progressive technology and the power of collaboration.

Do you like new challenges? Are you ready to reach new heights in your career and become part of an established disruptor? If so, come join us and help redefine the Canadian banking landscape!

The Sr. Director of Wealth Engineering will set the vision, guide architecture, set the proper engineering culture and enable a multi-disciplinary technology team to bring industry-leading digital products and experiences to market through agile practices.

Is this role right for you?
In this role, you will:

Oversee the design, development, deployment, and operationalization of highly scalable & sustainable enterprise-wide technology internal products, components, and tools to support the overall digital ecosystem.
In close collaboration with Digital Wealth Leaders (e.g. Engineering, Design, Product, Analytics, Delivery), lead execution against identified digital capabilities roadmaps and vision through agile software delivery and enabling a high velocity engineering environment.
Promote co-creation and reusability on a global scale working with different teams in different countries to accelerate futures software developments.
Build a high-performance environment, engineering culture and implement a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their Community of Practice by fostering an inclusive work environment and communicating vision/values/business strategy and managing succession and development planning for the team.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role?
We'd love to work with you if you have:

10+ years’ experience in a leadership role managing large complex enterprise-level technology projects and programs with significant technology and operational components
5+ years in Wealth Management businesses/investment industry
Expert knowledge of software development and design principles for highly scalable, enterprise level technology stacks
Expert knowledge in modern agile principles and in a range of modern technologies and frameworks including working knowledge of the full stack
Flexibility to adapt to new and evolving environments and a demonstrated willingness and aptitude for picking new things up quickly
Strong leadership and relationship building skills
Extensive experience with automation, deployment and testing practices at scale
Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to semi-technical audiences

What's in it for you?

You will be part of a diverse and inclusive team of Client-focused go-getters looking to learn from each other in an environment that celebrates and recognizes success!
You will have access to thousands of online and in person courses so you can shape your career growth with the support from diverse industry leaders.
You will get our help to save for your future and to invest in your total wellbeing through our Tangerine benefits*.
You belong here, we are equal and un-complicated. Bring your true self to work, dress codes don’t apply here.
You will enjoy workspace flexibility and all the excitement that comes from working at the official Bank of the Toronto Raptors.
Tangerine employees participate in Scotiabank’s pension & benefits programs (available to permanent employees)

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

At Tangerine we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the team, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know.

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform
for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers
, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining
Autodesk Operations Solutions
, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations.
Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Engineering Director to lead MaintainX's Platform division. Platform owns the seven foundational teams every product engineer builds on: AI Builder, DevOps, Compliance, Testing Frameworks, Backend Frameworks, Mobile Frameworks, and SRE. This is a manager-of-managers role for someone who wants to define how a high-growth engineering org operates at scale.

What You’ll Do

Own the roadmap and operating model for Platform Engineering: set division-level priorities, manage cross-team dependencies, and translate business goals into multi-quarter platform investments.
Lead and develop a team of Software Development Managers - coaching on people development, technical judgment, and organizational effectiveness across seven teams.
Set the engineering standards every product team depends on: framework conventions, reliability targets, compliance posture, and CI/CD health.
Drive MaintainX's AI-native platform strategy - the AI Builder team's agent orchestration, tool registry, and developer environments sit in this division; your job is to ensure the org extracts real leverage from them.
Own division-level reliability: SLO definitions, incident response frameworks, on-call health, and the systemic path from incident to prevention.
Partner with the CTO and peer engineering leaders on org design, architectural decisions, and headcount planning.
Represent Platform Engineering to the business — translating infrastructure investment into engineering velocity, developer experience, and customer trust.
An expert level of English, both spoken and written, is required, as the individual will need to lead platform engineering managers across multiple teams, present technical priorities to executive stakeholders, and align with engineering leaders outside Québec on a daily basis.

About You

10+ years in software engineering with 5+ years in engineering leadership, including 2+ years managing managers across multiple teams.
Technical depth in at least two of: distributed systems, backend or mobile frameworks, platform engineering, reliability engineering - credible enough to make hard hiring decisions and engage in architecture reviews.
Track record of owning platform or infrastructure-focused teams at a growth-stage B2B SaaS company, with demonstrated impact on engineering velocity.
AI-forward: you set direction for teams building on LLMs and agentic workflows, and you hold your org to an AI-native standard.
Systems thinker who identifies organizational bottlenecks and eliminates them without creating new ones — you design teams, not just manage them.
Strong communicator who can represent platform complexity and tradeoffs clearly to product, finance, and executive stakeholders.

Nice To Have

Experience leading a Testing Frameworks, Quality Engineering, or Developer Productivity platform function.
Hands-on history scaling developer platforms through rapid headcount growth (Series D+).
Familiarity with CMMS, IoT, or industrial SaaS domains.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running.
Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits.
Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging.
We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

Compensation Range: CA$173K - CA$254K

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product Management, AI Product Strategy
jobs.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

Senior Director, AI Product Strategy - On-Site - Full Time, Permanent Role.

Location:
OpenText Headquarters – Waterloo, Ontario

The Opportunity

OpenText manages information for the largest organizations worldwide — and we're now rebuilding that foundation around AI. As enterprises embrace a new era of intelligent automation and generative AI, we are building the next generation of content, data, and AI-driven solutions that empower organizations to unlock knowledge, drive efficiency, ship AI that enterprises actually trust.

Your Impact

We are seeking a Senior Director, AI Strategist and Product Management to lead our initiatives for Generative AI and Agentic AI product portfolios within the Content Management Business Unit. This senior leadership role will shape OpenText’s AI product roadmap and execution, driving innovation at scale across our enterprise SaaS solutions.

The ideal candidate is a product leader and hands-on AI strategist — someone who combines deep technical expertise in AI and data science with proven experience leading global product and development teams to deliver transformative business outcomes. You will own both the 'why' and the 'what' — not just the roadmap document.

What The Role Offers

Define and execute the AI strategy for all our Content Management products.
Lead and mentor a global AI product organization, fostering innovation, accountability, and deep client empathy.
Architect and deliver production-grade agentic systems using LangChain, LangGraph, A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocols, and other transformative AI frameworks to create adaptive, multi-agent enterprise solutions.
Partner with Development, Data Science, and Data Cloud teams to develop scalable, secure, and high-performing AI-driven products.
Shape OpenText's point of view on AI — representing the company at industry events, client forums, and analyst briefings — including Gartner, Forrester, and major client advisory boards — as a thought leader in enterprise AI.
Report into and co-own strategy with the Content BU leadership and C-level executives to align AI strategy with business goals and ensure measurable outcomes.
Ensure product roadmaps align with modern data architectures and leverage knowledge graphs and unstructured data management to enhance AI model grounding and reduce hallucinations.

What You Need To Succeed

7+ years of proven experience in data science, AI, and ML — with at least 3 years leading product organizations at enterprise scale — and hands-on exposure to building and optimizing Agentic AI systems.
Deep expertise in Agentic AI frameworks, including MCP, A2A protocols, Google ADK, LangChain, and LangGraph (critical).
Demonstrated success leading Product Management organizations in enterprise software or cloud platforms.
Strong background in AI/ML, data management, and modern data architectures (Lakehouse, Data Fabric, knowledge graphs).
Experience with unstructured data management, grounding AI models, and context engineering to reduce hallucinations in generative AI systems.
Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale SaaS solutions through collaboration with global, cross-functional teams.
Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive presence — with the ability to influence strategy and engage C-level stakeholders.
Track record of shipping: you can point to specific AI products you've taken from concept to production, with measurable outcomes.

One Last Thing

OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned.

Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.

OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket at Ask HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

Compensation:
At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off.

AI Usage Disclosure:
As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.
